thread:
Marta (Product): tossing out a proposal: 'Adaptive Tiers' — base small commit, modular addons (priority lane, cached responses, expanded surge). goal: lower barrier for mid-market while letting us upsell predictable addons. quick take?

Dev (Finance): love the concept. need a clear revenue guardrail though. what's the base commit and addon margin targets?

Marta (Product): base commit = 20% of existing Starter; addons priced as % uplift (eg +40% priority, +25% cache). aim for blended gross margin >= current starter.

Noah (Sales): examples help. some customers want a hard monthly cap. can we offer hard-cap addon vs default soft-cap? sales will push hard-cap for procurement.

Priya (Legal): hard-cap is fine but contract needs explicit conversion rules for trials and edge cases. also define what 'priority lane' means SLAs wise.

Omar (Eng): implementation notes: priority lane = queue priority + reserved capacity shard. cache addon = per-customer KV capacity + eviction policy. surge = pooled credits or per-tenant bursting? both have ops complexity.

Tess (Product Ops): ops prefers per-tenant surge with optional pooling. pooling across tenants requires stronger billing and fraud controls. also need automated monthly reconciliation export.

Marta (Product): rough pricing sketch (working doc):
```
Base commit: 20% starter = X tokens/mo
Addons:
 - priority lane: +40% of base price
 - cache (1GB): +25% of base price
 - surge bucket (0.5x commit): one-time addon or monthly: +30%
Overage: soft-cap path -> warn & throttle after commit+surge; hard-cap path -> block above limit (unless allowed) and bill only for negotiated exceptions.
```

Dev (Finance): two suggestions: 1) stepped overage multiplier (1.5x then 2.5x) to deter persistent spikes; 2) require minimum 3-month term for any addon bundle to protect revenue.

Noah (Sales): stepped multipliers ok but will complicate quoting. can we hide the steps in the quote UI and show an estimated worst-case cost? Sales would like a single-line monthly ARR estimate + a checkbox for hard-cap.

Priya (Legal): add mandatory notice period for auto-convert trials (eg 7 days). for pooled surge opt-in, require explicit consent and data-processing note if it's cross-tenant.

Omar (Eng): dev roadmap impact:
- priority lane: +2 sprint infra (+routing changes, metrics)
- cache addon: +1.5 sprint (KV store config, per-tenant limits)
- surge (per-tenant): +1 sprint; pooled: +3 sprints (allocation + fairness algos)
Also need request tagging for billing: add header X-Redwood-Billing-Tag.

Tess (Product Ops): launch checklist draft: pilot customers (n=3), billing smoke test (3 months simulated), SLA test for priority lane under load, legal sign-off, quoting UI wire approved.

Marta (Product): pilot strategy: two mid-market pilots for modular adoption, one enterprise pilot for hard-cap + SLA. offer 90-day trial on base commit; addons trial opt-in for 30 days. auto-convert requires signed T&C opt-in.

Dev (Finance): add a churn model to see impact of 3-month minimum vs month-to-month. also model blended ASP if 30% of customers buy cache addon.

Noah (Sales): field request: a lot of customers ask for 'burst for free first 2 months' — can't promise that without finance ok.

Marta (Product): we should design migration paths: existing Starter customers can opt-in to Adaptive with pro-rated credits or keep current plan. include a migration FAQ.

Priya (Legal): include migration opt-in acceptance flow and ensure we capture consent timestamp. add a clause for disputed usage within 45 days to allow adjustments.

Omar (Eng): will add a small API flag for plan_id and addon_set; will post schema in #eng-platform tomorrow.

Tess (Product Ops): success metrics for pilot: 1) 25% attach rate for at least one addon within 90 days, 2) billing reconciliation <1% drift vs simulation, 3) no production SLOs broken by priority lane.

Marta (Product): action items: @Omar share infra estimate and header spec; @Dev run revenue/churn sims; @Priya draft contract snippets for soft/hard cap + pooled surge consent; @Tess create pilot checklist & onboarding flow. I'll draft the roadmap card after estimates. :rocket:

launch-bot: Actions recorded: Omar - infra estimate; Dev - revenue sims; Priya - contract snippets; Tess - pilot checklist. Deadline: next product sync.

Noah (Sales): I'll line up 3 pilot prospects and sync pricing expectations once Dev gives sims.

Dev (Finance): reminder: include a floor revenue calc for small commits to avoid net-negative deals.

Marta (Product): noted — will include floor & 3mo minimum in roadmap card. we'll review during next planning deep-dive.
